Official overview
Experience sophisticated urban living at Oakwood Premier Coex Center Seoul, perfectly positioned on Teheran-ro, at the heart of Seoul's dynamic commercial and financial district. Our prime location ensures you are seamlessly connected to both business hubs and popular tourist attractions. The property is directly linked to the expansive COEX Mall via convenient underground walkways, allowing you to explore a world of upscale shopping, exquisite dining, and entertainment without stepping outside. Within a short stroll, you can reach the COEX Convention and Exhibition Centre, the Korea World Trade Centre, and the City Air Tower.

Choose from 281 lavishly furnished, luxury serviced apartments, each designed to provide a perfect blend of modern elegance and exceptional service. Our studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments offer ample space, featuring separate sitting areas and captivating city views. Every apartment features a fully equipped modern kitchen, complete with an open bar counter and an in-suite washing machine, ensuring a comfortable and independent stay. For your comfort, beds are fitted with down comforters, and a pillow menu is available, alongside designer toiletries and bathrobes.

Guests benefit from a comprehensive array of exclusive facilities and signature services. Maintain your fitness routine at our Health & Fitness Club, featuring a well-equipped gym, an indoor pool with natural light, and a relaxing sauna. For business needs, the Genesis Business Center provides comprehensive services, including meeting facilities equipped with state-of-the-art technology. Dining is a pleasure at Oak Restaurant & Bar, our all-day dining venue, serving a wide array of Korean and Western cuisines. For younger guests, a dedicated Children's Play Area is available.

Additional conveniences include a 24-hour reception, concierge services, and complimentary on-site parking and valet service. We also offer limousine service and professional laundry services. Our property is even pet-friendly, welcoming up to two pets per room (subject to a deposit). Oakwood Premier Coex Center Seoul has been recognised for its excellence, ensuring the convenience and comfort of a luxury serviced apartment in one of Seoul's most desirable districts.

Official summary
Oakwood Premier Coex Center Seoul, perfectly located in Teheran-ro, in the heart of commercial and financial district in Seoul, is ideal for expatriates, relocating families and international business travelers. Connect to business and tourist attractions with ease by foot, public and private transport and retreat to 281 lavishly furnished, luxury serviced apartments that offers the perfect blend of modern elegance, exquisite style and exceptional service. Dine in Oak Restaurant and Bar, the all-dining restaurant, or rejuvenate with any one of the recreational facilities such as an indoor pool, sauna and fitness center.

Official apartment hub
Luxury Apartments Seoul. Official Our Rooms / apartment cards (published): Studio Superior, Studio Premier, One Bedroom Superior, Two Bedroom Superior.

Official location
Oakwood Premier Coex Center Seoul enjoys a prime position in the vibrant Teheran-ro area, a key commercial and financial district within Seoul's renowned Gangnam-gu. Our property is an integral part of the COEX complex, providing direct access to the vast COEX Mall, the COEX Convention and Exhibition Centre, and the Korea World Trade Centre, ensuring unparalleled convenience for business engagements. Beyond the immediate complex, leisure destinations are easily reached: the serene Bongeunsa Buddhist Temple is just moments away, and Seven Luck Casino Gangnam COEX Branch offers entertainment.

The central location ensures effortless access to major city hubs. Gangnam Station is approximately 4 kilometres away, a quick 7 to 13-minute subway ride or a 10 to 15-minute taxi journey. For connections to the wider national rail network, Seoul Station is approximately 12 to 15 kilometres from the property. The surrounding area, rich with upscale shopping and dining, means you are ideally placed to experience the best of Seoul's business and entertainment scene.

Getting here (official)
From Incheon International Airport (ICN): By Taxi/Private Transfer: The journey typically takes around 60–80 minutes, depending on traffic. By Limousine Bus 6103: Offers direct service to the COEX City Air Terminal, which is just a short walk from our entrance.
From Gimpo International Airport (GMP): By Taxi/Private Transfer: The journey typically takes around 45–60 minutes.
Nearest public transport: City Airport Terminal: Exceptionally close, just 168 metres from the property. Samseong Subway Station (Line 2): A mere 10-minute walk from the property (via Exit 5 into COEX Mall). Bongeunsa Subway Station (Line 9): Also within a 10-minute walk (via Exit 7 into COEX Mall).

Official FAQ
What types of accommodation are available at Oakwood Premier Coex Center Seoul? The property offers 281 luxury serviced apartments, including studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom options. Each apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, a washing machine, and a private bathroom with a deep soaking bathtub.
Is Oakwood Premier Coex Center Seoul suitable for business travellers or families? Yes, the serviced apartments are ideal for expatriates, relocating families, and international business travellers, offering amenities and services tailored to both long-term stays and corporate needs, alongside family-friendly facilities like a children's play area.
Does Oakwood Premier Coex Center Seoul offer pet-friendly accommodation? Yes, Oakwood Premier Coex Center Seoul is pet-friendly, allowing up to two pets per room with a weight limit of 22 lbs. A deposit is required.
What facilities can guests enjoy at Oakwood Premier Coex Center Seoul? Guests can enjoy a Health & Fitness Club with an indoor pool, gym, and sauna, as well as an indoor screen golf facility. There is also the Oak Restaurant & Bar, a Children's Play Area, and business centre services including meeting facilities.

Studio Superior (official apartment card)
Retreat to the elegantly dressed, chic studio apartment - a perfect oasis for the busy executive or independent traveler. Rejuvenate your senses with a shower or a pampering soak in the bathtub; and recharge with a restful slumber in the Hollywood bed, easily converted from a double bed to two twin beds. Each apartment is equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi; multi-channel cable; a comprehensive entertainment system; western-style kitchen with a dishwasher, microwave and convection oven; and an automatic tilt window which opens up to 45 degrees.

Studio Premier (official apartment card)
Bright, airy and flushed with natural light, our studio apartments offer a spacious sanctuary perfect for business executives or independent travelers. An open plan layout harmoniously connects the living, dining and larger kitchen space with the bedroom. Lounge in the Hollywood bed, easily converted from a double bed to two twin beds and freshen up in the adjoining bathroom, fit with a marble bathtub and separate standing shower. Each apartment is equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi; multi-channel cable; a comprehensive entertainment system; western-style kitchen with a dishwasher, microwave and convection oven; and an automatic tilt window which opens up to 45 degrees.

One Bedroom Superior (official apartment card)
The epitome of modern and sophisticated living, our one-bedroom apartments are generously-sized and perfect for travel-savvy executives and couples who place a premium on space. The living area's wooden floor adds charm and elegance, while a marble bathtub and individual sauna-steam shower enhance the shower experience. Experience ultimate comfort with the plush king bedding fitted in the bedroom and a separate closet for added storage space, perfect for extended stays. Each is equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi; multi-channel cable; a comprehensive entertainment system; western style kitchen with a dishwasher, microwave and convection oven; automatic tilt window which opens up to 45 degrees; and an in-room sauna.

Two Bedroom Superior (official apartment card)
Designed for families and guests on extended business trips, our two-bedroom superior apartments are lavishly furnished with fine finishes and a full set of premium amenities. Catch up with friends over a sumptuous meal in the dining area fit for four; and enjoy a superb, deep slumber in the plush king and queen bedding, available in the master and guest bedroom respectively. Each is equipped complimentary Wi-Fi; multi-channel cable; a comprehensive entertainment system; western style kitchen with a dishwasher, microwave and convection oven; storage closet; automatic tilt window which opens up to 45 degrees and an in-room sauna.

Official overview
Experience refined city living at Somerset Palace Seoul, a premier choice for serviced apartments situated in the dynamic Gangbuk area. Our residence offers a tranquil environment, complete with picturesque gardens and expansive city views, providing a peaceful retreat amidst the urban bustle. Located within Seoul's diplomatic, business, and financial heart, you will find an abundance of restaurants, shopping, and entertainment venues along the charming Insa-dong and Jongno-gu areas, all within easy reach. This strategic position ensures effortless access to Seoul's historical and commercial pulse.

Our thoughtfully designed apartments cater to every need, from the comfortable Studio options to the expansive One-Bedroom and Two-Bedroom suites to the luxurious Penthouse. Each apartment is a sanctuary, featuring stylish furnishings, a fully equipped kitchen (including hob, microwave, toaster, chinaware, and cutlery), and separate living areas. For ultimate convenience, every residence includes a washing machine and tumble dryer, a home entertainment system, an HD television, and a dedicated work desk. Private bathrooms are fully equipped with bathrobes and hair dryers, ensuring a truly comfortable home-away-from-home experience.

Beyond your private space, Somerset Palace Seoul offers a comprehensive range of facilities and services. Maintain your routine at our complimentary 24-hour fitness centre and gymnasium. For relaxation and leisure, ascend to our rooftop garden, where you can enjoy a refreshing dip in the seasonal outdoor swimming pool, all offering stunning city vistas. Families will appreciate the dedicated children's playroom. Our Residents' Lounge serves a delightful continental and buffet breakfast daily, and a business centre with meeting and seminar facilities supports your professional needs.

Your peace of mind is paramount, assured by our 24/7 on-call wellness and security teams and 24-hour reception. We ensure seamless convenience with daily housekeeping, laundry and dry cleaning services, and secretarial assistance. Guests benefit from complimentary on-site car parking (one vehicle per apartment) and an EV charging station.

Ascott Clean360
Somerset Palace Seoul has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitments to safety, wellness and cleanliness.

Official summary
Strategically located in the Gangbuk area, Somerset Palace Seoul offers a tranquil environment teeming with picturesque gardens and sprawling city views. The area is Seoul’s diplomatic, business and financial hub, and also houses an array of restaurants, shopping and entertainment facilities all along the Insa-dong and Jongo-gu areas.

All serviced apartments come with a fully equipped kitchen, complimentary broadband Internet access, and daily housekeeping services (except Sundays and Public Holidays).

Complimentary Wi-Fi connectivity, daily housekeeping service (except Sundays and Public Holidays) and linen change thrice a weekly is also available.

The spacious and stylish 1-Bedroom Executive is designed for comfort and style with generous living and dining areas, a plush bedroom and bathroom, a fully equipped modern kitchen and contemporary furnishings and fittings for the ultimate urban living experience. Complimentary Wi-Fi connectivity, daily housekeeping service (except Sundays and Public Holidays) and linen change thrice weekly is also available.

Whether you are in Seoul for business or leisure, the 80 sqm 2-Bedroom Executive is the ideal long stay apartment for you. As befitting the foremost 2-bedroom apartments Seoul has to offer, each serviced apartment comes with a generous living and dining area, a fully equipped kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms for privacy and comfort. Penthouse Premier (official apartment card)
The spacious Penthouse Premier features stylish interiors and modern appliances to make your stay a hassle-free one. As part of one of the finest luxury apartments in Seoul, Korea, these abodes offer complimentary Wi-Fi, air-conditioning and daily housekeeping service (except Sundays & Public Holidays) and linen change thrice weekly, so guests can enjoy all the comforts of home with the conveniences of a hotel.

Official location
Somerset Palace Seoul enjoys a truly advantageous location in the heart of Gangbuk, a district renowned for its tranquil environment and rich cultural heritage. Located within Seoul's diplomatic, business, and financial hub, the hotel offers immediate access to the vibrant shopping and dining experiences of Insa-dong and Jongno-gu.

The location boasts unparalleled walkability to historical landmarks: the magnificent Gyeongbokgung Palace and Gwanghwamun Square are just a five to seven-minute stroll away. The charming Insa-dong (antique shops, teahouses) and the UNESCO World Heritage site of Changdeok Palace are also within a ten-minute walk. For retail therapy, Myeong-dong and Namdaemun Market are easily accessible via a short subway or car ride.

Connectivity is effortless: Anguk Subway Station (Line 3) is a quick three to five-minute walk away, with Jonggak (Line 1) and Gwanghwamun (Line 5) stations also conveniently nearby. This comprehensive subway access ensures efficient travel across Seoul, including a direct limousine bus connection from Incheon International Airport.

Getting here (official)
From Incheon International Airport: By Taxi: It takes approximately 50 minutes by taxi and cost about KRW 90,000 to get to the residence. By Airport Limousine Bus: Take the limousine bus (#6011) to Somerset Palace Seoul and costs about KRW 17,000. (Limousine Bus Stop : 1st Floor, No. 5B for Terminal 1 / Traffic center Basement 1, No. 31 for Terminal 2) It takes approximately 60 minutes to Anguk-dong (Anguk Station) Stop and 3 mimutes walk to the residence.
Nearest public transport: Subway stations: Anguk (3-minute walk), Gwanghwawun (5-minute walk), Jonggak (5-minute walk). Official FAQ: The closest subway station to Somerset Palace Seoul is Anguk (Line 3, Exit 6) and Jonggak (Line 1, Exit 2) and Gwanghwamun (Line 5, Exit 2) station are also close to the property.

Official FAQ
How many people can stay in an apartment? 2 persons for Studio, Superior, One-Bedroom Deluxe and One-Bedroom Executive types, 3 persons for Deluxe Room Twin, Executive Room Twin, Executive Suite and Two-Bedroom Executive types, 4 persons for Penthouse.
What are the check-in and check-out times at Somerset Palace Seoul? Check-in time for Somerset Palace Seoul is 3PM and check-out time is 12PM.
Does Somerset Palace Seoul offer business services? Yes, Somerset Palace Seoul offers guests access to business services such as Business centre, Meeting rooms, Seminar rooms during your stay (Charges may apply).
Is there a minimum night stay requirement at Somerset Palace Seoul? No, there is no minimun night stay requirement at Somerset Palace Seoul.
Does Somerset Palace Seoul allow pets? Yes, pets are allowed at Somerset Palace Seoul. Our Pet Policies are KRW 30,000 + 10% vat per night for short-term and for long-term KRW 1,000,000 + 10% vat for security deposit and KRW 150,000 + 10% vat per month.
What is the cancellation policy if you wish to cancel the booking? The cancellation policy is booking must be cancelled by 3PM the day before arrival to avoid a cancellation charge amounting to 1 night's rental fee (for less than 29 nights stay) and 7 days before arrival to avoid a cancellation charge amounting to 3 nights' rental fee (for 30 nights stay and above).
What is the smoking policy at Somerset Palace Seoul? Somerset Palace Seoul does not permit smoking in property building.
Does Somerset Palace Seoul have airport transportation? No, Somerset Palace Seoul does not offer airport transportation for guests. Airport transportation vehicle booking service is available upon request via email at enquiry.seoul@the-ascott.com (*Charges may apply).
Does Somerset Palace Seoul offer disability access? Yes, Somerset Palace Seoul has a good range of accommodation options for disabled guests.
What types of serviced apartments are available at Somerset Palace Seoul? Somerset Palace Seoul offers a range of serviced apartments, including Studio, Superior, One-Bedroom Deluxe, One-Bedroom Executive, Deluxe Room Twin, Executive Room Twin, Two-Bedroom Executive, Executive Suite and Penthouse suites, catering to various guest needs and group sizes.
What are the facilities available at Somerset Palace Seoul? Some of the more popular amenities offered at Somerset Palace Seoul include free Wi-Fi access, Residents' lounge, Fitness centre, Children's playroom, Business centre*, Rooftop Garden and Rooftop swimming pool (*Charges may apply).
Is there housekeeping service? Yes, we offer daily housekeeping for short-term and three times a week for long-term stay.
Is there car parking available at Somerset Palace Seoul? Yes, car parking is available at Somerset Palace Seoul (1 car park per each room).
How much is an extra bed? An extra bed will be charged at KRW 44,000 per night. Requests for an extra bed or crib are subject to management confirmation and are available in selected room types only.
What food & drink options are available at Somerset Palace Seoul? Guests can enjoy food and beverages at Crystal Jade Shanghai Palace (Chinese Restaurant, 1Fl.), The Kitchen Il Forno (Italian Restaurant, 1Fl.), Dutch and Bean (Café, 1Fl.) and Sushi Wa (Japanese Restaurant, 2Fl.).
What are some of the property amenities at Somerset Palace Seoul? Top room amenities include kitchenette, air conditioning, flat screen TV, etc.
Are toiletries provided at Somerset Palace Seoul? Yes, toiletries such as Towels, Shampoo, Body cleanser, Lotion are provided at Somerset Palace Seoul (Toothbrushes and Toothpaste are not provided).
What are some of the child-friendly services and amenities available? Somerset Palace Seoul offers Children's playroom, Outdoor Garden, Rooftop Garden, Rooftop swimming pool and provides baby cots upon request (Subject to availability).
Is breakfast included at Somerset Palace Seoul? It varies depending on your type of booking, if breakfast includes you can have breakfast at 2nd floor of Residents' Lounge (Monday to Friday 06:30-10:00 / Saturday, Sunday and Public Holidays 07:00-10:30) and if breakfast not included, you may purchase the breakfast coupon at our Guest Services (0-2 years old : Free / 3-6 years old : 13,200 / 7 years old and above : 22,000).
What key amenities can I expect in my apartment at Somerset Palace Seoul? Each apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, a washing machine and tumble dryer, a home entertainment system, an HD flat screen television, an in-room electronic safe, air conditioning, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. Please note that toothbrushes and toothpaste are not provided.
How do I get to Somerset Palace Seoul? Somerset Palace Seoul is easy to access from Anguk (Line 3), Jonggak (Line 1), Gwanghwamun (Line 5) station and it is near to Jogyesa Temple and Gwanghwamun Square.
What popular attractions are close to Somerset Palace Seoul? If business is what brings you to Seoul, you'll appreciate the convenience of the Fraser Place Namdaemun Seoul's meeting rooms, fitted with state-of-the-art audio-visual technology and high-speed internet. This makes them an ideal place for conferences or simply catching up on work.
